notes.title: Gamepad support!
notes.content:
Features:
- Controller support!!! It was quite a task as game was intentionally optimized to be played by mouse+keyboard. After two months of hard work playing with gamepad is now a comparable experience to mouse+keyboard.
- Playing using only a keyboard is also possible.
- Options->Keys redesigned - a dedicated dialog is shown when assigning a key
- New scroll/book: Weaken - reduce enemy statistics: Strength, Defense, Dexterity, Magic, Health
- some small fixes
